title: Can I have the apple one?
scene: Snack time. He picks which snack and how many.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Snack's on the table. Pick one.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can I have the apple one?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I want two. My tummy says two.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: One now, one after the park.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Fine. But I pick the later one.

variations: apple one -> banana one; after the park -> after nap
